data.revised_prompt: Simple centered icon asset, bold silhouette, minimal detail, high contrast, readable at small sizes. Create a high-quality 3D chibi-style education-app avatar of a fictional Chinese schoolgirl aged about 8–14, healthy, natural, and friendly. Single character only. Square 1:1 composition. Frontal or slight three-quarter view, highly focused on the head. Full hair outline visible, with face and hair occupying 75%–85% of the frame. Only a very small amount of neck and shoulders visible at the bottom; absolutely not a half-body portrait. She has a high bun hairstyle, no straight bangs, and wears a teal narrow sporty headband. Bright brown eyes. Confident, cheerful smile. Soft studio lighting, delicate modeling, smooth materials, same polished style as a refined AI school homeroom assistant / principal assistant set, but clearly a student. Bottom shows only a tiny bit of white school-collar neckline, no emblem, no text. Background: solid soft light lavender fully filling the square edge-to-edge, no white border, no transparency, no circular frame, no ring, no halo, no scene. Ensure hairstyle, expression, and accessory are clearly distinguishable at small sizes. Avoid teacher, adult, microphone headset, suit, heavy makeup, jewelry, head cut off, hair cut off, chin cut off, face too small, large shoulders, white background, circular background, frame, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, multiple characters, realistic photo, flat 2D illustration, baby proportions, dark tones, low resolution, distorted facial features.
